visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Keys Inserted on the Wrong Side
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An in-order walk of a binary search tree should print the keys in ascending order, but this program prints them in descending order.

solution.explanation: The defining rule of a binary search tree is that smaller keys go left and larger keys go right. With the sides mirrored, in-order traversal (left, node, right) visits the keys from largest to smallest.
